sources.snippet: Qwen3 8B - Heretic (Abliterated) An abliterated version of Qwen's Qwen3-8B created using Heretic v1.2.0 (git master). This model has reduced refusals while maintaining model quality, making it suitable as an uncensored text encoder for image generation models like Klein 9B.

sources.snippet: The p-e-w/Qwen3-8B-heretic is an 8.2 billion parameter causal language model, a decensored version of the original Qwen3-8B, created using the Heretic v1.1.0 tool. It features a 32,768 token context length, extendable to 131,072 tokens with YaRN, and uniquely supports seamless switching between a "thinking mode" for complex reasoning (math, code) and a "non-thinking mode" for general dialogue ...
